scope: Build hygiene only. No product/build implementation in the freeze.

cases.target: The exact 17 W07 paths are present in the baseline public artifact with the frozen sizes.
A future W07-R1 public artifact publishes none of the 17, unless an explicit STOP is raised because consumer evidence changed.
Required source files remain in repository/source; W07 is publish pruning, not source deletion.
Books/flipbooks/PDF/audio/images/licenses/originals outside the authorized 17 are unchanged.
es/investigacion/_import/** remains usable source for Investigación but is absent from future publish.
QA manifests needed by tests remain available before/pre-prune or outside publish.
Current runtime data such as cromos.json, estudios-textos.json and juegos-120.json remains present.
React byte-identical pairs are not deduplicated by W07.
Two clean Linux builds from the same SHA produce byte-identical public artifact manifests.
Before/after artifact manifest is SHA-bound and records path/bytes/SHA-256.
W06 route checker runs read-only against the same clean dist.
Publication/indexation contract does not worsen from 1003/986/4/13/999.
Privacy/storage audit does not worsen relative to frozen baseline error count.
CSP and security-header audits do not regress.
netlify.toml remains absent from dist.
No sensitive/secret material is introduced into the public artifact.
Future artifact diff is limited to removing the exact authorized 17 paths; no other path is added/removed/changed.
W07 performs no media conversion, recompression or optimization.
git diff --check passes.
Rollback restores the prior publish policy/artifact without deleting source.
